info.title: Eventy API
info.description: OpenAPI contract for the Eventy API.

get.description: Organizer admins and super admins can fetch overview metrics, recent events, upcoming sessions, and attention items scoped to their access.
Super admins can list organizers with the primary linked admin account plus event and session totals for each organizer.

post.description: Super admins can create an organizer together with its linked organizer admin account.

get.description: Super admins can fetch a single organizer with its admin list and organizer-scoped event summaries in one response.

patch.description: Super admins can update an organizer's name and slug.

delete.description: Super admins can delete an organizer.

get.description: Super admins can list every organizer admin attached to a specific organizer.

post.description: Super admins can add another organizer admin to an existing organizer.

get.description: Super admins can fetch a single organizer admin attached to a specific organizer.

patch.description: Super admins can update an organizer admin's name and email.

delete.description: Super admins can delete an organizer admin as long as the organizer will still have at least one admin account remaining.

patch.description: Super admins can set a new password for a specific organizer admin account.
Super admins can update a category by ID.

delete.description: Super admins can delete a category by ID.

get.description: Returns a category by slug for public discovery pages.
Returns published events enriched for the public discovery experience, including organizer and category display data, the next upcoming session, and derived ticket summary fields.
Returns a published event with public-facing organizer, category, session, and ticket information.
Organizer admins only see events belonging to their organizer. Super admins can see every event.

post.description: Organizer admins create events for their own organizer. Super admins can create for any organizer by passing organizer_id.

get.description: Organizer admins can only fetch events belonging to their organizer. Super admins can fetch any event. The response includes sessions and ticket types for dashboard configuration.

patch.description: Organizer admins can only update events belonging to their organizer. Super admins can update any event.

delete.description: Organizer admins can only delete events belonging to their organizer. Super admins can delete any event.

post.description: Creates or updates a pending registration and sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's email.
Verifies the email OTP, creates the user, and returns an auth token.
Generates a new OTP for an existing pending registration and sends it to the same email.
Rotates the refresh token and returns a new access token plus refresh token.

patch.description: Authenticated users can change their password by providing their current password.

post.description: Generates a password reset OTP and sends it to the user's email.
Resets the user's password using the emailed OTP.

description.example: Curated screenings, premieres, and cultural film nights.

organizer_id.description: Required for super admins. Ignored unless it matches the token organizer for organizer admins.
